English: The next skill cast from hand deals 64% increased damage.
Chinese: 下 1 个从手中释放的技能造成的伤害提升64%。

English: Empowers your next skill, increasing its damage by &a% <color=#FF7A33>(200% of &user's ATK)</color>.
Chinese: 强化自己的下 1 个技能，使其造成的伤害增加&a%<color=#FF7A33>(&user攻击力的200%)</color>。

English: Increases <color=purple>Pain damage</color> taken by &a% <color=#FF7A33>(200% of &user's ATK)</color>.
Chinese: 受到的<color=purple>痛苦伤害</color>提升&a%<color=#FF7A33>(&user攻击力的200%)</color>。

English: Fixed Ability damage increased by &a% <color=#FF7A33>(200% of &user's ATK)</color>.
Chinese: 固定能力造成的伤害提升&a%<color=#FF7A33>(&user攻击力的200%)</color>。

English:
Critical Rate increased by &a% <color=#FF7A33>(100% of &user's ATK)</color>.
<color=purple>Pain damage</color> you deal can now crit.
Chinese:
暴击率提升&a%<color=#FF7A33>(&user攻击力的100%)</color>。
自己造成的<color=purple>痛苦伤害</color>可以暴击。

English:
The next single-target skill used on &user deals/heals 100% more. Draw 1 skill from a target, then remove this buff.
At the end of the turn, perform a 'Basic Attack' on &user once.
Chinese:
下 1 个对&user释放的单体技能伤害量/治疗量提升100%，抽取 1 个目标的技能，然后解除该增益。
回合结束时，对&user释放 1 次“基础攻击”。

English: Upon death, deals <color=purple>&a Pain Damage</color> to all enemies <color=#FF7A33>(33% of &user's ATK per stack)</color>.
Chinese: 死亡时，对所有敌人造成<color=purple>&a痛苦伤害</color><color=#FF7A33>(&user攻击力的33%/每层)</color>。

English: After reaching 6 stacks, the Fixed Ability is replaced with "Finale of the Score."
Chinese: 叠加至 6 层后，固定能力会替换为“谱曲终末”。

English:
Whenever an ally uses a skill, gain 1 stack of 'Melody.'
At 6 stacks, the Fixed Ability becomes 'This Side and the Other.'
This buff is instantly removed when the character reaches Death's Door.
Chinese:
其他队友释放技能时，自身也会获得 1 层“乐声”。
“乐声”叠加至 6 层时，改为使固定能力变为“彼世与彼岸”。
进入濒死状态时，解除该增益。

English: This buff's "Damage per Turn" equals the sum of all debuffs' "Damage per Turn" on the target.
Chinese: 这个增益的“每回合伤害量”等于目标持有的所有减益“每回合伤害量”之和。

English:
All your skills in hand become 'Song of Red and Black.'
Removed when entering Near-Death status.
Chinese:
手中的自己的技能全部变为“红与黑的歌”。
进入濒死状态时，解除该增益。

English:
After using a Fixed Ability, clear all Overload on self.
Heal 20% of all damage dealt.
Chinese:
使用固定能力后，清除自身过载。
每当造成伤害时，将伤害的20%转换为体力值。

English: You are no longer affected by "Tuning."
Chinese: 自身不再受到“定音”影响。

English:
Each time using own skill, gain 1 stack of 'Melody.'
At 6 stacks, the Fixed Ability is replaced with 'Finale of the Score.'

Takes 100% increased damage from allies.
For each fallen ally, Phrolova permanently gains 1 stack of 'Melody.'
Chinese:
每次释放自己的技能时，获得 1 层“乐声”。
“乐声”叠加至 6 层后，固定能力会替换为“谱曲终末”。

受到来自队友的伤害提升100%。
队伍中每有 1 个角色阵亡，弗洛洛就会永久持有 1 层“乐声”。
游走于生死之间的残星会会监，神秘而危险的指挥家…… 她沉默地挥舞指挥棒，手中调律频率演奏出的“灵魂”旋律，既可塑造美好的世界，也可唤来千军万马。

English: Look, humans are creatures who live under the illusion of safety, clinging to life in fear, dependent on everything, resisting death.
Chinese: 瞧，人是活在安全之下的生物，被恐惧威胁着，依附一切而苟存，拒绝死亡。

English: All is but a fleeting bloom.
Chinese: 一切就都不过是昙花一现。

English: Don't leave yet—the performance isn't over.
Chinese: 别急着离开，这场演出还没有结束。

English: Be careful, I might toss my baton at any moment.
Chinese: 小心了，我可能会在任意时刻，将指挥棒抛掷出来。

English: The warm yet melancholic first movement hides in the dark night, lonely and desolate.
Chinese: 温馨而伤感的第一乐章隐藏在暗夜中，孤独、寂寞。

English: The gloomy, mournful second movement conceals unease and malice.
Chinese: 阴暗、悲戚的第二乐章深藏着不安与险恶。

English: The lively third movement carries a playful, fantastical air.
Chinese: 明快又活泼的第三乐章拥有了幻想中的谐谑气氛。

English: The decisive and powerful fourth movement heralds a battle hymn in full swing.
Chinese: 果断而有力的第四乐章降下酣畅淋漓的战斗颂歌。

English: When you fail enough times, you lose the emotions tied to failure—and thus, no more worries.
Chinese: 失败的次数足够多时，就会失去面对失败的情感，也就不再拥有烦恼。

English: Come, let us complete this long-awaited performance together.
Chinese: 来吧，让我们一起，完成这场万众期待的演奏。

English: A duet with me? Are you sure?
Will the coming notes be beautiful enough...?
Chinese: 即将到来的声音，是否足够美妙……

English: What meaning will you give them?
Chinese: 你将赋予它们什么意义？

English: To understand the cycle of life, we must experience it again and again.
Chinese: 为领悟生生不息，一次次经历。

English: A relationship built on mutual understanding is reassuring, isn't it?
Chinese: 心知肚明的互相利用，反而会让人心安，不是吗？

English: But we must master both life and what comes after.
Chinese: 可我们，应掌握活着和死亡后去活着。

English: Aren't you afraid? It will raise its dagger and pierce the veil between life and death.
Chinese: 不害怕吗，它将有力地举起匕首，刺破生与死的面纱。

English: When you fail enough times, you lose the emotions tied to failure—and thus, no more worries.
Chinese: 失败的次数足够多时，就会失去面对失败的情感，也就不再拥有烦恼。

English: The heart must not become a tomb.

Fixed Ability damage increased by 64%. After using a Fixed Ability, the next skill cast from hand deals 64% increased damage. I am not there, nor have I died. I will follow death, masking fear with pleasure, trading the future for the past.
Chinese: 固定能力造成的伤害提升64%。 释放固定能力后，下 1 个从手中释放的技能造成的伤害提升64%。 我不在那里，也没有死去。 我将追随死亡，用享受掩盖恐惧，以未来换回过去。

English:
Cast twice, dealing <color=purple>Pain damage</color>.
Draw 1 'New World Rhapsody' from the deck or discard pile.
If 'Reincarnation' is active, also inflict 1-turn Stun (<sprite=2>80%).
Chinese:
重复释放 2 次，并造成<color=purple>痛苦伤害</color>。
从牌库或弃牌库中抽取 1 个“新世界狂想曲”。
持有“重世”增益时，还会使目标(<sprite=2>80%)眩晕 1 回合。

English:
Draw 1 'New World Rhapsody' from the deck or discard pile.
If 'Reincarnation' is active, also prioritize drawing 1 of your own skills.
Chinese:
从牌库或弃牌库中抽取 1 个“新世界狂想曲”。
持有“重世”增益时，还会额外优先抽取 1 个自己的技能。

English: Prioritize drawing 1 of your own skills.
Chinese: 优先抽取 1 个自身的技能。

English:
Can only be used while <color=red>at Death's Door</color>.
Deals <color=purple>Pain damage</color>.
Chinese:
仅在<color=red>处于濒死状态</color>时才可释放。
造成<color=purple>痛苦伤害</color>。

English: Generate 1 rare skill you haven't learned in hand.
Chinese: 在手中生成 1 个自己未学会的稀有技能。

English: When this skill is exchanged or discarded, take <color=purple>6 Pain damage</color>.
Chinese: 这个技能被交换或丢弃时，受到<color=purple>6痛苦伤害</color>。

造成<color=purple>12痛苦伤害</color>。
抽取 3 个技能。

English: Deals <color=purple>Pain damage</color>. Then, take <color=purple>&a Pain damage</color>聽<color=#FF7A33>(100% of max HP)</color>.
Chinese: 造成<color=purple>痛苦伤害</color>。使自身受到<color=purple>&a痛苦伤害</color><color=#FF7A33>(自身最大体力值的100%)</color>。

English:
Can only be used with 'Tuning' active.
Removes 'Tuning.'
Chinese:
仅在持有“定音”增益时才可释放。
移除“定音”增益。

English:
Kills all allies except yourself.
Then, add all skills from ally decks to your deck, changing their owner to yourself.
Fully recharge 'Lucy's Necklace' to 3 stacks.
Chinese:
使自身以外的所有友军阵亡。
那之后，向牌库中添加所有友军牌组中的技能，并使持有者改为自身。
使“露西的项链”充能次数填充至 3 层。

Chinese: 下 1 个从手中释放的技能造成的伤害提升64%。

Increases <color=purple>Pain damage</color> taken by &a% <color=#FF7A33>(200% of &user's ATK)</color>.
Chinese: 下 1 个技能造成的伤害增加&a%<color=#FF7A33>(&user攻击力的100%)</color>。

English: Fixed Ability damage increased by &a% <color=#FF7A33>(200% of &user's ATK)</color>.
Chinese: 固定能力造成的伤害提升&a%<color=#FF7A33>(&user攻击力的100%)</color>。
